description: Account lookup returns 500; the service dereferences a status that the contract says a pending account does not have.
howSeeded: Inlined the status mapping in AccountService.mapAccount so it calls getStatus().getCode() unconditionally, without the null check pending accounts require.
decidingEvidence: A NullPointerException with product frames in mapAccount, for a valid request on an account the contract says has no status yet, while verified accounts are served normally.
